A Python exact arithmetic checker independently verifies F3/F9/F27 counts and Hermitian incidences; finite enumeration is not substituted for the universal proof.

value.rationale: The reduced union of all 56 exceptional curves is a canonical divisor on a distinguished del Pezzo surface; its arithmetic descent is a structural invariant distinct from the published F9-fullness result. No irreducible component is rational over F3, yet exactly ten singular boundary points persist over every odd extension. This is a genuine geometric Frobenius phenomenon with a complete 351-dimensional boundary H1 representation and 400-dimensional total compact-support open cohomology, not an arbitrary number-table entry. The full compactly supported spectrum and zeta classify a natural nonproper surface motivically, with plausible reuse in exceptional-curve complements and arithmetic open-surface studies.
